scope: Exactly four observed official PDFs; three current sectors and one town point, no neighbor expansion.
geometryMethod: Parse embedded GCS WKT + GPTS/LPTS and page transformation; affine in stored projected CRS. Native continuous explicitly closed red circonscription_isie2023 path, wholly inside viewport and both active clips. No invented alignment, repair, snapping, smoothing, buffer or cutting. Native paths are preserved separately.

officialVsOriginal.qualification: No area or overlap ratio computed from a self-intersecting ring; unchanged native path retained.

officialVsPacked.qualification: No area or overlap ratio computed from a self-intersecting ring; unchanged native path retained.

currentAnchor.qualification: Unrepaired self-intersecting native ring: ordinary valid-polygon containment withheld; literal nonzero/even-odd winding reported separately.

townPoint.qualification: Unrepaired self-intersecting native ring: ordinary valid-polygon containment withheld; literal nonzero/even-odd winding reported separately.

pairTopology.qualification: Separately georeferenced complete native paths; no snapping or repair.
One complete native ring is self-intersecting; no snapping or repair and no polygon overlap/topology assertion.

limitations: Official source is 2023 electoral district/imada map, not an assertion of present-day boundary certification.
Map base imagery/POI labels are geographic context, not independent boundary evidence.
Original OSM and packed OSM share source lineage.
Same town name or Wikidata does not make a town point identical to an administrative sector.
